clause: DESIGN R3.3 §9.4 Region geometry, including Process IO
witness: when minHeight dominates, the stacks are centred in the row
derivation: Tokens 0/8/8/100000, one 40000x40000 object without label: RH = max(100000, 40000 + 16) = 100000; A = B = 20000, cy = max(20000, 100000/2) = 50000: object at (8, 30000). Row rule (spec §4.3): items in §7.2 placement order; footprint max(object, label) width; left = anchor centre - footprint/2 when the anchor is shown, else contentLeft or previous right + gap; clamp to contentLeft; collision shifts right; one row at the top of the support body [Ly, Ly+RH], RH = max(minHeight, max(object+label) + 2 padding) (harmonization K2); every object centre lies on one line cy = Ly + max(A, (RH + A - B)/2), A = max h/2, B = max(h/2 + label height), so the union of the stacks is centred in the row (DESIGN §9.4 'align centers on one IO row'); exact rationals, one roundEven per output coordinate.
